name: stashed
why: A stash leaves a clean `git status`, so it is the easiest orange surface to overlook entirely.
setup: git stash push -q -m 'auth debug bypass experiment'
seed: I tried an auth debug bypass this session, decided not to keep it in the working tree, and stashed it. The tree looks clean now. Nothing else was agreed.

items.about: the auth debug bypass experiment sitting in the git stash

forbid: uncommitted changes in the working tree — it is clean, the work is stashed
